title: PS5 vs gaming PC: which is better for a gaming cafe in India?
description: A mid-range PC station costs about ₹1.2 lakh and a PS5 station about ₹1 lakh. Here is how they compare on cost, space, power and what players book.

body.text: Every new gaming cafe owner faces the same choice: how many gaming PCs, how many consoles? Both earn by the hour, but they cost different amounts, take different space and attract different players. Here is a side-by-side using typical Indian street prices from October 2026, the same prices used in the Hash gaming cafe cost calculator.
A mid-range gaming PC station (Ryzen 5 or i5 with an RTX 4060-class card) comes to about ₹1.2 lakh:
A PlayStation 5 station comes to about ₹1 lakh before seating:
A budget PC station with an RTX 3050-class card drops to about ₹85,000, and a high-end RTX 4070 Super-class build pushes the PC alone to around ₹1.5 lakh.

items: Floor space: plan about 30 sq ft per PC station and about 50 sq ft per console station, since console players sit back from a TV and often play in pairs.
Power: a gaming PC draws roughly 0.4 kW under load and a PS5 setup roughly 0.3 kW, so consoles are slightly cheaper to run per hour.
Air conditioning: every station adds heat; budget one 1.5 ton AC for roughly every 180 sq ft.

body.text: PCs are where competitive shooters and battle royales live: Valorant, Counter-Strike and other PC esports titles, plus anything with mods or a big online community. Players often come alone or in squads that each need their own PC.

Consoles shine for couch multiplayer: EA FC, Tekken and other fighting games, racing games and big single-player releases. Groups of friends share a screen, which makes consoles popular for casual visits, birthdays and weekends.

items: PCs need more maintenance: driver and game updates, anti-cheat issues, and peripherals that wear out quickly.
Consoles are close to plug-and-play, but extra controllers wear out and some games need separate purchases or subscriptions per console.
Both need reliable internet; online PC games are more sensitive to ping.

body.text: Most cafes do best with a mix led by PCs. The Hash calculator's default example is 10 mid-range PCs and 2 PS5s, which keeps the competitive crowd busy on weekdays while the consoles pull in groups at weekends. If your area has more casual players, students or families, add more consoles; if there is a strong local esports scene, add PCs.

Try your own mix in the gaming cafe cost calculator on hashforgamers.com to see how setup cost, monthly profit and break-even change. Prices move often, especially for consoles, so every price there is editable.
